task_meta.description: 每日渠道汇总（合成示例）

statement_sequence.normalized_sql: /* 任务：客户渠道汇总（合成示例） */ /* 口径：仅统计生效状态的客户 */ INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE mart.channel_summary PARTITION(dt = '${bizdate}') SELECT s.customer_id AS customer_id /* 客户号 */, CASE WHEN s.channel_code = 'A' THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END AS channel_name /* 渠道编码（合成值域） */, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount /* 金额合计（元） */ FROM ods.channel_event AS s LEFT JOIN dim.channel AS d ON s.channel_code = d.channel_code /* 按渠道编码补充维度 */ WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' /* 仅生效状态 */ GROUP BY s.customer_id, CASE WHEN s.channel_code = 'A' THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END
